title: Airlines (flight delay)
order: Stream replay in source order. The data set is commonly used as a drift stream (MOA/Ikonomovska version); rows are not guaranteed to be strictly time-sorted, so RetrainWise treats it as an ordered replay, not a verified chronology.
citation: Ikonomovska, E. Airline dataset (derived from the 2009 Data Expo / US BTS data), distributed via MOA and OpenML.
preprocessing: Cached as-is in source order with the target renamed to 'target' and labels stored as text. Imputation, scaling and one-hot encoding are fitted only on each model's own training window (see preprocessing.py).
usage_note: Research/educational use; re-check the licence on the source page before redistribution.
